changes: Neutral white and gray surfaces from Silicon UI, with neutral-8 small labels for WCAG AA contrast; blue accent retained.
Visible workspace previous/next buttons removed; plus button and tab shortcuts retained.
Suggester invitation label maps to existing commenter API permission; starts in Suggesting mode and cannot rename or accept suggestions.
Click suggested text to review it inline; accept converts it to normal text, reject removes the proposal. Review is also available in Comments and More.
Custom double-click and context menu for selection copying, formatting, comments and review.
Slash and document-link menus track the text during scrolling, fit the viewport and scroll their options independently.
Formatting toolbar starts open while writing.
Portalled submenu focus no longer moves the parent menu highlight to unrelated items.

full_browser_suite.note: Initial full run before final corrections. Eight previously failing scenarios remain; one contrast regression and two changed-default expectations were corrected and rerun.

preexisting_failing_scenarios.observation: Image comment toolbar does not reappear after the image already has a comment.
Desktop commenter drag-selection helper receives empty selection.
PDF area click does not expose the expected active thread card.
Imported-title assertion still looks for H1 inside banner.
Shared list lookup by original document title fails at line 791. This scenario also failed in the prior baseline, at a later assertion; current failure was not separately repaired.
Viewer menu assertion still omits the existing Select item.
Markup-title assertion still looks for H1 inside banner.
Share dialog assertion expects obsolete explanatory text.

final_focused_checks.name: WCAG AA public/workspace pages, desktop/phone, device light/dark preferences and keyboard navigation
New-document formatting default and signed-in public-link suggestion access
Suggester invitation, role enforcement, inline accept/reject and persisted Markdown; 390/320px review controls; text menu, submenu highlights and slash scroll

limitations: The full browser suite is not green; eight existing failing scenarios are recorded above.
Suggestion acceptance and rejection were verified against two local test accounts, without changing the user's production document.
